A very nice days work if I say so myself.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Denner]], to a [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]] pilot|<ref name="SWG:BtRF" />}}
The '''3rd TIE Wing''' was a [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wing]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was assigned to the defense of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] construction in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].<ref name="SWG:BtRF" />
{{Imp-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The 3rd TIE Wing appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BtRF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The 3rd TIE Wing was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:BtRF" />
